# PG Near Me

> Free directory of PGs (paying-guest accommodation), hostels and shared flats across India. Seekers browse and contact owners directly, at no cost; owners list for free. No brokerage, no booking/payments — this is a discovery and lead-generation directory, not a transaction platform.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://pgnearme.co.in/) — search entry point, interactive map, featured cities
- [Map](https://pgnearme.co.in/cities) — interactive map of covered cities plus city cards (route: `/cities`)
- [About](https://pgnearme.co.in/about) — what the product is and isn't
- [For owners](https://pgnearme.co.in/for-owners) — free listing pitch for PG/hostel owners
- City listing pages: `https://pgnearme.co.in/pg/[city]` — e.g. `/pg/vadodara`
- Listing detail pages: `https://pgnearme.co.in/pg/[city]/[listing-slug]`

## How search and filtering works

Each city page lists published PGs/hostels with filters for gender type (Girls-only / Boys-only / Co-ed), budget, sharing type (single through 5-bed), and food preference. Listings may also show girl-safety fields when available (Verified for Women, female warden on-site, curfew, CCTV coverage, entry system, nearest police station, emergency contact). Every listing shows price range, amenities, house rules, and a contact-reveal flow — no login required for seekers.
